translations.web: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass, or a clanging cymbal.
translations.bsb: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.
translations.kjv: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
translations.asv: If I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am become sounding brass, or a clanging cymbal.
